spans.s: किंस्त्य किंस्त्य, अम्, n. a kind of fruit (?).

किनाट किनाट, अम्, n. the inner bark of a
tree.

किन्दुविल्व किन्दुविल्व, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
or according to various readings किन्दुविल्ल, केन्दु-
विल्ल, or तिन्दुविल्ल, N. of the place where Jaya-deva
was born or where his family resided.

किन्धिन् किन्धिन्, ई, m. a horse; (a various
reading for किल्किन्.)
किन्नु किन्-नु, ind. See under किम् below.

किं-यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. what wishing?
—किं-
राजन्, आ, m. a bad king.
—किं-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्,
of what shape?
—किं-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, poor, mean,
insignificant.
—किं-वदन्त, अस्, m., N. of an imp
or goblin who lies in wait for children.
—किं-
वदन्ति, इस् or ई, f. (lit. what do they say?), the
common saying or rumour, report, tradition, tale.
—किं-वराटक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who says ‘what
is a cowrie?’ i. e. an extravagant careless man who
does not value small coins.
—किं-विद्, त्, त्, त्, what
knowing ?
—किं-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of what power?
—किं-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who says ‘what is
behaviour?’ i. e. one who is not careful in his man-
ners.
—किं-व्यापार, अस्, आ, अम्, following what
occupation?
—किं-शारु, उस्, उ, m. n. the beard of
corn; (उस्), m. an arrow; a heron.
—किं-शिल, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. (land) having small stones or gravelly
particles.
—किं-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, of what habits? in
what manner generally existing or living?
—किं-
शुक, अस्, m. the tree Butea Frondosa, a tree bearing
beautiful red blossoms, and hence often alluded to
by poets; (अम्), n. the blossom of this tree; [cf.
पलाश and सु-किंशुक.]
—किंशुकोदक (˚क-
उद्˚), अम्, n. a decoction made from the blossoms
of the tree Butea Frondosa and used for colouring.
—किं-शुलुक, अस्, m. a variety of the tree Butea
Frondosa.
—किंशुलुका-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a moun-
tain.
—किं-सखि, आ, m. a bad friend.
—किङ्-कर,
अस्, m. a servant, a slave; (Ved.) a particular part of
a carriage; a kind of Rākṣasa; N. of a people;
(आ), f. a female servant; (ई), f. the wife of a servant.
—किङ्कर-त्व, अम्, n. the condition of a servant
or slave.
—किङ्कर्तव्य-ता or किङ्कार्य-ता, f. any
situation or circumstances in which one asks one's self
what ought to be done ? [cf. इतिकर्तव्य-ता.]
—किङ्-
कल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—किङ्-काम्य, nom. P.
-यति, to wish what ?
—किङ्-काम्या, ind. (old inst.
for -काम्यया), Ved. from a desire for what?
—किङ्-
कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, having what reason or cause?
—किङ्-क्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, one who says ‘what is
a moment ?’ i. e. a lazy fellow who does not value
[]
moments.
—किङ्-गोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to what
family ? — 2. किञ्-चन, see under 2. क and किम् above.
—किञ्चन-ता, f. something, somewhat.
—किञ्चिज्-
ज्ञ (˚चित्-ज्ञ), अस्, आ, अम्, knowing a little, a mere
smatterer.
—किञ्चित्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, doing anything;
(अ-किञ्चित्कर, one who has not done anything
wrong.)
—किञ्चित्-काल, अस्, m. a little-time, some time.
—किञ्चित्-परे, ind. a little after.
—किञ्चित्-प्राण, अस्,
आ, अम्, having a little life left.
—किञ्चिन्-मात्र, अम्,
n. only a little.
—किञ्-छन्दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, conver-
sant with which Veda ? (which Veda does he know?)
—किञ्-जप्य, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—किञ्-ज्योतिस्,
इस्, इस्, इस्, having which light?
—किन्-तनु, उस्, m.
an insect described as having eight legs and a very
slender body, a species of spider.
—किन्-तमाम्,
ind. whether? whether of many ?
—किन्-तराम्, ind.
whether ? whether of two?
—किन्तु-घ्न, अस्, m. one
of the eleven periods called Karaṇa (destroying every
‘but’).
—किन्-त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. an adj. formed
from किं त्वम्, ‘what thou?’ to denote the impu-
dent manner in which a drunken man asks questions.
—किन्-दत, अस्, m., N. of a sacred well.
—किन्-
दम, अस्, m., N. of a Muni.
—किन्-दर्भ, अस्, m.,
N. of a man.
—किन्-दान, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—किन्-दास, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—किन्-देवत,
अस्, आ, अम्, having what deity ?
—किन्-देवत्य, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to or devoted to what deity?
—किन्-नर, अस्, m. (what sort of man?), a mythical
being with a human figure and the head of a horse,
originally perhaps a kind of monkey [cf. वा-नर],
in later times (like the Naras) reckoned among the
Gandharvas or celestial choristers and celebrated as
musicians; also attached to the service of Kuvera;
(with Jainas) one of the eight orders of the Vyantaras;
(अस्), m., N. of a prince; an epithet of Nara, a son
of Vibhīṣaṇa; (with Jainas) the N. of the attendant
of the fifteenth Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī; N.
of a place; a kind of musical instrument; (ई), f. a
female Kinnara; the lute of the Caṇḍāla.
—किन्नर-
वर्ष, अस्, m. a division of the earth said to be
north of the Himālaya mountains.
—किन्नरेश or
किन्नरेश्वर (˚र-ईश्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of Kuvera
as lord of the Kinnaras.
—किन्-नामधेय, अस्, आ,
अम्, or किन्-नामन्, आ, आ, अ, having what name?
—किन्-निमित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having what cause or
reason? (अम्), ind. from what cause ? for what
reason? why? wherefore?
—किम्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्,
having what motives or aim ? (अम्), ind. from what
motive? what for? wherefore? why?
—किम्-आख्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, having what name?
—किमिच्छक, अस्,
आ, अम् (fr. किम् + इच्छा), what one wishes or desires,
anything desired.
—किम्-पच, अस्, आ, अम्, cooking
what? one who cooks nothing; miserly, avaricious.
—किम्-पचान, अस्, आ, अम्, miserly, niggardly,
avaricious; [cf. मितम्-पच.]
—किम्-पराक्रम,
अस्, आ, अम्, of what power? of what energy?
—किम्-
पर्यन्तम्, ind. to what extent? how far? how
long?
—किम्-पाक, अस्, आ, अम्, unripe; ignorant;
stupid; not arrived at mature age, childish; (अस्),
m. a Cucurbitaceous plant, Trichosanthes Palmata;
also Cucumis Colocynthus [cf. महा-काल]; (अम्),
n. the fruit of this plant.
—किम्-पुना, f., N. of a
river.
—किम्-पुरुष or किम्-पूरुष, अस्, m. a
mongrel being (according to the Brāhmaṇas an evil
being similar to man), perhaps originally a kind of
monkey; in some instances the word seems to mean
merely a low and despicable man; in later times
the word is usually identified with किन्-नर, though
sometimes applied to other beings, in which the
figure of a man and that of an animal are combined,
(these beings are supposed to live on Hemakūṭa, and
are regarded as the attendants of Kuvera; with Jainas
the Kimpuruṣas, like the Kinnaras, belong to the
Vyantaras); N. of one of the nine sons of Āgnīdhra,
having the Varṣa Kimpuruṣa as his hereditary por-
tion; a division of the universe, one of the nine
Khaṇḍas or portions into which the world is divided,
and described as the country between the Himācala
and Hemakūṭa mountains, also called किम्पुरुष-
वर्ष.
—किम्पुरुषेश्वर (˚ष-ईश्˚), अस्, m. an
epithet of Kuvera.
—किम्-प्रकारम्, ind. in what
[]
manner?
—किम्-प्रभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
what power?
—किम्-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
what strength or power?
—किम्-भरा (?), f. a kind
of perfume, commonly called Nalī.
—किम्-भूत,
अस्, आ, अम्, being what? (अम्), ind. how? in what
manner or degree? like what?
—किम्-मय, अस्, ई,
अम्, Ved. consisting of what?
कीन कीन, अम्, n. flesh; [cf. कीर.]

कीनार कीनार, अस्, m., Ved. = कीनाश (?),
a cultivator of the soil; (Sāy.) a vile man.

कीनाश कीनाश, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
क्लिश्; according to others fr. किम् and नाश), a
labourer or cultivator of the soil; the poverty of this
class of men in India was proverbial, so that कीनाश
meant sometimes ‘a very poor man;’ according to
native lexicographers कीनाश may be an adj. and has
the following meanings, cultivating the soil; poor;
covetous, niggardly; small, little, killing animals or
killing secretly; (अस्), m. a kind of monkey [cf.
कीश]; an epithet of Yama; a kind of Rākṣasa.

किन्-ता, f. ‘the state of whom?’ any despicable
state or condition, contemptibleness; किन्तया, with
meanness, contemptibly.
किन्-देव, अस्, m. a demi-god [cf. किन्-नर].
